1223.speaker: Player_Romus

1231.speaker: Player_Romus

1309.speaker: Narrator
1309.text: As the doors closed behind him, I sank into my chair, my mind heavy with the weight of the discussions.

1310.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1310.text: "But before we dive into that, Titus has important news to share."

1311.speaker: Titus Gordion
1311.text: "But before we dive into that, I have important news to share."

1312.speaker: Titus Gordion
1312.text: "It goes without saying that given Su Omina's strong dislike for the Bluds, this posed a significant dilemma for him."

1313.speaker: Narrator
1313.text: I was here to receive the latest updates on Zille.

1314.speaker: Narrator
1314.text: We were here to discuss the latest updates regarding Zille.

1315.speaker: Narrator
1315.text: And his stern gaze remained undiminished by the partial paralysis that had forced him to step down from the council.

1316.speaker: Narrator
1316.text: Then they parted ways, each heading in a different direction.

1317.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1317.text: "Identified through the serial numbers of the materials retrieved from the crime scene, courtesy of Wehlen's investigation team."

1318.speaker: Titus Gordion
1318.text: "You just saw the exchange of key components used to make the bomb--"

1319.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1319.text: “I hope so. You just saw the exchange of key components used to make the bomb--"

1320.speaker: Titus Gordion
1320.text: "Once Wehlen finds out the investigation results, they will know we were... mistaken earlier."

1321.speaker: Titus Gordion
1321.text: "If we publicize the evidence implicating Lespia, Wehlen will know we were lying before."

1322.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1322.text: "If we can get Lespia to stop sending aid to Pales, we'll gain a major edge in the war."

1323.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1323.text: "We found that he made a trip to the docks, checking in on one of those days."

1324.speaker: Titus Gordion
1324.text: "We discovered he made a trip to the docks, checking in on one of those days."

1325.speaker: Titus Gordion
1325.text: "We discovered he paid a visit to the docks, registering in on one of those days."

1326.speaker: Titus Gordion
1326.text: "He operates as a recognized spy from Lespia, stationed at their consulate in Zille."

1330.speaker: Player_Romus
1330.text: "I could really go for blowing off some steam right about now, wouldn't you say?"

1331.speaker: Titus Gordion
1331.text: “I hope so, sir. You just witnessed the exchange of some of the main components used in the bomb."

1332.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1332.text: “The exchange of the main components used in the bomb."

1333.speaker: Titus Gordion
1333.text: "The exchange of some of the main components used in the bomb."

1334.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1334.text: “Then allow me to clarify. The exchange of some of the main components used in the bomb--"

1335.speaker: Titus Gordion
1335.text: “Then allow me to provide some clarification. You just saw the exchange of key components used to make the bomb."

1343.speaker: Titus Gordion
1343.text: "I am confident that we will find a solution that aligns with the best interests of Rizia."

1362.speaker: Titus Gordion
1362.text: "If we publicize the evidence implicating Lespia, Wehlen will know we were... mistaken."

1363.speaker: Titus Gordion
1363.text: "The Golden Guard has already apprehended the supposed culprit in the bombing."

1367.speaker: Narrator
1367.text: He nodded at my security councilor.

1368.speaker: Titus Gordion
1368.text: "Well. Let's first have a look at our current standing with President Smolak."

1372.speaker: Narrator
1372.text: He paused, as if afraid to go on.

1374.speaker: Player_Romus
1374.text: "Do not fear to bring your king bad news, Titus. Whatever happened, it is my responsibility to handle it."

1381.speaker: Titus Gordion
1381.text: "You tasked the Golden Guard with continuing our investigation into Su Omina's role in the Friendship Day incident."

1382.speaker: Titus Gordion
1382.text: "You tasked the Golden Guard with investigating Pales' potential role in the Friendship Day incident."

1386.speaker: Titus Gordion
1386.text: "However, despite your much-appreciated expansion of our ranks, we are experiencing an unanticipated shortage of manpower."

1387.speaker: Titus Gordion
1387.text: "As you know, a number of Golden Guardsmen have been deployed in the Pales conflict."

1388.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1388.text: "Yes, and the tales of their prowess in combat have already become the stuff of legend. We're grateful for your colleagues' service."

1390.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1390.text: "But it sounds like you're telling His Majesty that you've got your hands too full to continue your investigation."

1391.speaker: Titus Gordion
1391.text: "I-- yes. The war forced the Golden Guard to put our investigative work on the proverbial back burner."

1392.speaker: Titus Gordion
1392.text: "In the meantime, our leads have gone cold. Even if we had the manpower, we wouldn't be able to pick up where we left off."

1393.speaker: Player_Romus
1393.text: "Hell and damnation, Gordion! I knew assigning this to you was a mistake."

1397.speaker: Player_Romus
1397.text: "I must say I'm disappointed in you. You should've brought this up with me when I sent your men to the front."

1398.speaker: Player_Romus
1398.text: "Rizia is fighting for our very right to exist. Compared to that, this investigation was mere small change."

1399.speaker: Player_Romus
1399.text: "So you're telling me you have no useful information to deliver me. After all this time."

1400.speaker: Player_Romus
1400.text: "I'm not upset with you. It wasn't that important of a task."

1402.speaker: Titus Gordion
1402.text: "You have my deepest apologies, Your Majesty. We assumed that your priority was Rizia's national security and acted accordingly."

1403.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1403.text: "Your mercy and grace in the face of your underlings' failures knows no bounds, Your Majesty."

1404.speaker: Titus Gordion
1404.text: "Thank you for understanding. We saw it the same way."

1405.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1405.text: "Now that that's out of the way, I suggest we move on."

1406.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1406.text: "Please, Your Majesty. Captain Gordion is a fine bodyguard and commands a mean military division."

1407.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1407.text: "His strength is in brute force, not detective work. Now that we've learned that lesson, we should move on."

1409.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1409.text: "You are not to make assumptions about His Majesty's needs. Now that we've learned that lesson, I suggest we move on."

1410.speaker: Player_Romus
1410.text: "Yes, let's not dwell on it. What else is on the docket for today?"

1411.speaker: Player_Romus
1411.text: "Do not demean your colleague, Duchess Azaro."

1412.speaker: Player_Romus
1412.text: "Point taken. I will trust in the Rizian Intelligence Service going forward."

1413.speaker: Narrator
1413.text: Titus was staring at Lucita in open indignance. She ignored it and spoke brightly.

1414.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1414.text: "That was far from my intention, Your Majesty. I'm sure the Golden Guard did their best."

1417.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1417.text: "You won't hear it. You'll see it."

1418.speaker: Narrator
1418.text: Two men in military uniforms followed her, pushing a film projector into the room.

1419.speaker: Narrator
1419.text: The trio's entrance spoke of urgency.

1421.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1421.text: “My apologies, Your Majesty. Urgent matters delayed my arrival."

1422.speaker: Player_Romus
1422.text: “I'll believe that when I hear it, Duchess."

1423.speaker: Player_Romus
1423.text: "Lucita. So glad you could finally join us. I was beginning to think you got lost in the maze of palace corridors."

1427.speaker: Player_Romus
1427.text: "Let's hope this doesn't devolve into a wild goose chase, Lucita."

1428.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1428.text: "Please forgive me, Your Majesty. I had urgent matters to attend to."

1429.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1429.text: "Please excuse my late arrival, Your Majesty. Urgent matters demanded my attention elsewhere."

1430.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1430.text: "My apologies, Your Majesty. I was unavoidably detained by pressing matters."

1431.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1431.text: "Suffice it to say we've had a breakthrough in the Friendship Day bombing case. A big one."

1436.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1436.text: "It won't. I can promise you that."

1438.speaker: Player_Romus
1438.text: "Lucita. So glad you could finally join us. I was beginning to think you weren't coming."

1439.speaker: Player_Romus
1439.text: "Let's pray this doesn't veer into a wild goose chase, Lucita."

1452.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1452.text: "Despite the lack of immediate leads, I wasn’t convinced that it was a dead end."

1453.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1453.text: "My instincts told me there was more to uncover, and as it turns out, I was right."

1454.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1454.text: "One of my operatives managed to get in deep with a record keeper in the forensics department of Wehlen's Security Ministry."

1455.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1455.text: "This man was rather unhappy with his current situation and was... susceptible to persuasion."

1456.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1456.text: "After some delicate negotiations and the promise of a better life elsewhere, he agreed to help us."

1459.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1459.text: "We knew Wehlen’s databases were extensive, but rarely do they go back more than a decade in their routine checks. This was the key."

1461.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1461.text: "Sure enough, after some thorough searching, our contact found a match. The fingerprints we discovered at the bombing scene matched those of a man named Viktor Karnov."

1462.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1462.text: "He was arrested over 25 years ago for disorderly conduct and public intoxication. He was only 16 years old."

1463.speaker: Player_Romus
1463.text: "Viktor Karnov? Should I know who that is?"

1464.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1464.text: "Indeed, Your Majesty. Viktor Karnov is a well-known spy for Lespia."

1465.speaker: Lucita Azaro
1465.text: "Stationed at their consulate in Zille, he’s been operating under the radar for years, seamlessly blending into various roles and avoiding detection."

1466.speaker: Player_Romus
1466.text: "So who is he and why is he important?"

1468.speaker: Player_Romus
1468.text: Enough with the generalities. I need specifics. What exactly did your operative find that we don’t already know?"

1469.speaker: Player_Romus
1469.text: "Impressive work. I’m curious to know more about what was discovered.

1470.speaker: Player_Romus
1470.text: "A part of me secretly wonders what it would be like to be arrested."

1471.speaker: Player_Romus
1471.text: "Ah, the good old carrot-and-stick approach. It seems we've managed to find a willing ally with a little incentive."

1472.speaker: Player_Romus
1472.text: "Sometimes, the promise of a better future is all that's needed to turn the tide."

1473.speaker: Titus Gordion
1473.text: "One of my operatives gained access to Wehlen's Security Ministry by infiltrating a network of underground informants and black-market traders."

1474.speaker: Titus Gordion
1474.text: "We'd previously identified a group of smugglers operating within Wehlen who occasionally dealt in sensitive information."

1478.speaker: Player_Romus
1478.text: "I can't say I condone such actions, but I suppose if it achieves the desired results, I can look the other way."
